name: Atla Style Z-Image-Turbo
description: This model was trained using extremely low resolution screenshots of the show "Avatar The Last Airbender" as I was getting some pretty severe artifacts when attempting to upscale. I'd reccomend a weight of 1 generally I've found that the range .9 (To fix character generations) and 1.15 (To force style) tend to work alright. V1 Notes This lora was not trained using any of the names of the character's within the show and therefore will not know the characters implicitly. Strengths and weaknesses Strengths: Decent quality environment and background Weaknesses: Strongly conforms to any stylistic tags in the prompt. (If you prompt for photorealism, you'll get photorealism) Struggles with characters in a variety of ways. Tries to render the characters in the same high detail manner of the environments in close-up shots Completely distorts the characters from a distance Tends to close the eyes of the characters without being prompted to do so. Prompt notes If you'd like to see some bending you can use the following prompt scheme: {subject} casts fire from their hands. {subject} is casting a spell causing water to swirl around them violently. {subject} is casting a spell that causes the boulder to levitate. etc.
